spec.caption:
Sample resume title: Junior Smart Contract Developer.

Summary: Built a local escrow demo and wrote Foundry tests for unauthorized and repeat withdrawals.

1. Sample entry in Key Projects & Portfolio:
Project Name: Sample Escrow Demo. Your Role: Personal practice project.

Description: Implemented deposit and withdrawal functions in Solidity.

2. Example test bullet: Wrote Foundry tests showing unauthorized callers and repeat withdrawals revert.

Two named failure cases answer the site's interview prompt about testing edge cases.

3. Example README: run 'forge test'; unauthorized callers revert; a second withdrawal reverts.

Use Link to project/contribution for your repository. The sample leaves it empty.

4. Example skills entries:
Technical Skills: Solidity, Foundry.
General Skills: Git, README writing.

Use the separate fields; each listed tool should match work visible in the project.

5. The sample resume contains Summary, Key Projects & Portfolio and Skills. Professional Experience and Education are empty.

Download PDF exports the preview.

Full resource: hashtagweb3.com/resume-builder/li
